_comment: STRUCTURELONGTAILPLAN Phase D #49 — wrapper pool letting the prairie-house override roll EITHER BWG design (prairie_house intact / abandoned_prairie_house ruin), 50/50. Foreign .nbt referenced by location (lazy, resolved at placement, only ever over biomeswevegone:prairie = BWG present); processors are minecraft:empty (NOT the foreign biomeswevegone:*_house lists, which reference a BWG block) so this Skyseed pool loads WITHOUT BWG — the only loss is the processors' cosmetic grass->dirt/moss weathering; each house's ruin/character is baked into its own NBT. Blank jigsaw target picks a random start element + auto-centres it.
